node.title: XR coordinate-special proper hypersurface reduction
node.statement: Once the light-triangle profile eliminant is nonzero, the coordinate-special stagnation locus inside that profile is a proper bounded-degree hypersurface in the aligned-support chart.
node.attack_surface: formal consequence of the nonzero determinantal eliminant supplied by xr_triangle_eliminant_form
node.falsifier: a nonzero profile eliminant whose coordinate-special vanishing locus is not a proper hypersurface
